aiSummary.oneLiner: Advanced modpack and toolset for enhancing the Night City environment.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Night City Evolution is a comprehensive modding framework designed to overhaul specific in-game environments and mechanics. It introduces new visual assets, optimized rendering scripts, and expanded AI routines for NPCs. The project utilizes a custom script injector to modify core game logic without permanently altering base executable files. This allows players and creators to experience a significantly enriched, highly detailed simulation that pushes the boundaries of the original engine.
keyFeatures: Visual overhaul: Replaces hundreds of textures and lighting maps with high-resolution alternatives.
Script injection: Utilizes a custom memory injector to safely alter game logic at runtime.
AI enhancements: Expands the behavioral routines of NPCs to create more realistic crowds.
Performance optimization: Includes custom memory management scripts to mitigate stuttering with high-res assets.
Modular design: Allows users to toggle specific features or visual changes independently.

useCases.title: Environment enhancement
useCases.description: Install the core pack to significantly upgrade the visual fidelity of the game world.

useCases.title: Gameplay customization
useCases.description: Tweak AI behaviors and spawn rates using the included configuration tools.

useCases.title: Asset integration
useCases.description: Use the framework to safely inject custom models and textures into the engine.

useCases.title: Performance tuning
useCases.description: Apply the optimization scripts to improve framerates on lower-end hardware.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Modding enthusiasts and players looking to enhance their gaming experience. It requires basic familiarity with mod managers and file structures.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Download the latest release and extract it to the game's root directory.
